snippet.title: Cubettiny - Trailer
snippet.description:
In the distant kingdom of Numeria, a magical cataclysm shattered the world's balance, breaking the realm into fragments. Each fragment of Numeria, now scattered across unknown dimensions, has become an intricate mosaic of mysterious environments, each filled with unique challenges and dangers. In this fragmented world, cubes—symbols of order and perfection—have become the sole source of energy capable of restoring harmony between dimensions.

Plex is a sad cube animated by determination. Created in a magical laboratory by an ancient, forgotten civilization, it has a vital mission: to collect the lost cubes and return them to their origins, restoring harmony among Numeria's fragments. Each recovered cube represents a piece of the energy needed to reunite the worlds and restore order to the mathematical universe.

As the protagonist gathers more cubes, new areas unlock, revealing ancient ruins and enigmatic places where even more cubes lie hidden. Only through the courage and ingenuity of our hero can Numeria rediscover harmony and return to its perfect form.
